simulation.title: Simulation Controls
simulation.subtitle: Start/stop attack traffic and capture snapshots for comparison and reports.

workflow.title: Step-by-Step Workflow
workflow.step1: 1) Open Scenario Composer and pick attack + business context.
workflow.step2: 2) Start simulation and capture baseline snapshot.
workflow.step3: 3) Enable/tune defenses in Defense Lab or Command Center.
workflow.step4: 4) Capture hardened snapshot and inspect Comparison View.
workflow.step5: 5) Export the bilingual report for implementation.
